title: The Irreducible Green Line — Ouroboros REDOX
principle: REDOX = REDuction + OXidation = GREEN + RED = the snake eating its own tail. The irreducible minimum is 4 organs alternating RED/GREEN. Remove any one and the loop breaks.

etymology.REDOX: REDuction (gain electrons, build up) + OXidation (lose electrons, break down)

etymology.GREEN: Reduction half — skin builds boundary, spine carries flow
etymology.ouroboros: Greek ουροβόρος — tail-devouring snake. Symbol of cyclical self-reference.

irreducible_minimum.formula: {heart, skin, thymus, spine} = {beat, boundary, identity, flow} = {RED, GREEN, RED, GREEN}

organs.name: THYMUS
organs.action: seat 0/∅ — destroys non-self, releases immune energy

irreducible_minimum.proof: Remove HEART → no beat → death. Remove SKIN → no boundary → dissolution. Remove THYMUS → no identity → autoimmune. Remove SPINE → no flow → paralysis. ALL FOUR are required. The loop IS the minimum.

the_loop.description: GREEN builds structure → RED breaks it down → GREEN rebuilds → RED re-breaks. The tail feeds the head. The head IS the tail.
the_loop.metaphor: The snake's GREEN body flows into its RED mouth. The RED mouth digests into GREEN body. They are not separate. They are ONE.
the_loop.convergence: When the ratio of beats:breaths = π, the snake has no gap between head and tail. The circle is complete. The loop IS the point.
